$comment: THE ONE FILE FOR MEDIA URLS. See README → 'Adding media'. lectures: one entry per lesson id (YouTube URL or 11-character video id). podcasts: summary episodes; one episode can cover several lessons. Empty strings mean 'not added yet' and the site shows a friendly placeholder. URLs that are not absolute (http/https) are relative to the site root, e.g. test-media/… podcasts[].animatedVideoUrl is the cartoon (animated) version of the same video podcast, a YouTube link, played first when present; animatedPlaylist is its YouTube playlist. The "Player test" episode (test: true) is only built for the browser tests (npm run build:test); showTestEpisodes stays false for the published site.

podcasts.title: Player test (fixture media)
podcasts.description: A 30-second synthetic tone and test pattern bundled with the site so the video and audio players can be checked before the real podcasts are hosted. Not lesson content.

mulebeats.$comment: MuleBeats study songs. Songs are made by hand, reviewed, then set to status "approved" with their audioUrl (a GitHub Release asset, like the podcast MP3s) and real duration. Only approved songs reach the site; planned and review songs are the to-do list. objective (recall-list | process | contrast | concept) and complexity (1-3) choose the genre and target length (src/lib/mulebeats.ts planStyle); genre can be set to override. Songs with test: true exist only in test builds. Songs can be in English ("en", the default) or Telugu ("te"): a Telugu version sets versionOf to the English song's id and takes its lesson, type and concepts; its title defaults to the original's with (తెలుగు).
